youtube_title: Petrol Pump Toilet Is NOT Staff Only #Shorts
youtube_description:
Every petrol pump in India must give these FREE to customers: air, drinking water, a clean toilet, a phone and a first-aid box (oil company dealer norms, confirmed in Lok Sabha, Jul 2025). In April 2025 a Kerala consumer commission (Pathanamthitta) ordered a pump dealer to pay ₹1.5 lakh compensation for refusing a woman the toilet. Refused? Ask for the complaint book, then complain on the oil company's portal or CPGRAMS.
Source: Lok Sabha Unstarred Q 812 (24 Jul 2025); Pathanamthitta DCDRC order (Apr 2025).

Road trip pe pump pe ruke, toilet maanga: 'bhai, public ke liye nahi hai.' Same bro? 😤 Rule: har petrol pump ko FREE dena hai: hawa, peene ka paani, saaf toilet, phone, first-aid box. Kerala consumer commission ne toilet mana karne pe dealer se ₹1.5 lakh compensation dilwaya (Apr 2025). Mana kare? Complaint book maango, phir oil company portal ya CPGRAMS pe complain.
Send this to the friend who's always hunting for a toilet on road trips.
